# Valkey Operator

> Valkey Operator is a Kubernetes operator for Valkey. It deploys and manages Valkey Cluster, Valkey Sentinel (failover) and replica instances from a single `Valkey` custom resource, with ACL users, TLS, online scaling and version upgrades. It is an independent open source project (Go, Apache 2.0) at github.com/chideat/valkey-operator, separate from the Valkey project's own valkey-io/valkey-operator.

It supports Valkey 7.2, 8.0, 8.1, 9.0 and 9.1 on Kubernetes 1.33 to 1.35. The high-level `Valkey` resource is in the `rds.valkey.buf.red/v1alpha1` API group; the `Cluster`, `Failover`, `Sentinel` and `User` resources are in `valkey.buf.red/v1alpha1`.

## Docs

- [Operator overview](https://chideat.github.io/valkey-operator/guides/operator-overview/): what the operator does, its architecture and the supported versions
- [User guide](https://chideat.github.io/valkey-operator/guides/user-guide/): installation, deployment, monitoring, passwords, customizing generated resources and troubleshooting
- [Valkey Sentinel on Kubernetes](https://chideat.github.io/valkey-operator/guides/valkey-sentinel-on-kubernetes/): a primary with replicas kept available by Valkey Sentinel
- [Valkey Cluster on Kubernetes](https://chideat.github.io/valkey-operator/guides/valkey-cluster-on-kubernetes/): a sharded Valkey Cluster, scaled online
- [FAQ](https://chideat.github.io/valkey-operator/faq/): short answers about architectures, versions, passwords, TLS and scaling

## API reference

- [API overview](https://chideat.github.io/valkey-operator/api/): the custom resources and their API groups
- [Valkey](https://chideat.github.io/valkey-operator/api/rds-v1alpha1-valkey/): the recommended resource for every architecture
- [User](https://chideat.github.io/valkey-operator/api/v1alpha1-user/): Valkey ACL users
